doc.title: Duffy Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 17, 1995

title: Closing thanks
summary: Thanks and goodbyes, with Duffy hoping to visit the school.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well on behalf of Hamilton College, it’s been a great pleasure speaking with Duffy Jackson, who speaks as eloquently as he plays I would like to say.
He’s had quite a day with the photo shoot.
I’m never going to forget this day, and you are a very integral part of the success and the happiness that I’m feeling right now, and all these jazz greats, phew.
I hope to come to your school sometime, and maybe jam with the students, I’d love to do that.
